title: DEC-301 item 1 build: sign and notarize the Ward release in release.yml (sign job, rehearsal, tests)
description: Builds the accepted design in the Developer ID path reference (WCLI-183, DEC-301 (a3)): a sign job in environment release on a hosted macOS runner that imports the operator-held certificate into a temporary keychain, signs with identifier ai.opum.ward, hardened runtime and timestamp, notarizes with an App Store Connect API key, and verifies; verify, attest (WCLI-109) and release then act on the signed bytes; workflow_dispatch rehearsal from main publishes nothing. No entitlements by default. May be built before any credential exists; it cannot be run until the operator completes steps 1 to 6. Follows WCLI-109 (PR 418) and WCLI-183 (PR 419). Release-path change: own dispatch-floor read and Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release.yml has a sign job, the only job reading the signing secrets, that runs no package manager and deletes its temporary keychain in an always-run step
The signed artifact passes codesign --verify --strict and a designated-requirement check naming the team id and identifier ai.opum.ward before upload
A workflow_dispatch run from main signs and notarizes and publishes nothing; the release job stays tag-only
verify, attest and release need sign and act on the signed bytes
test/release-workflow.test.ts pins the above and the runbooks and ADR 0001 are updated

implementationNotes: Job layout: build (no environment, ad-hoc artifact as now) -> sign (environment release, macos-15, needs build; downloads artifact; no bun or npm; pinned actions only) -> verify (re-checks signed asset) -> attest (needs build, sign, verify) -> release (needs build, sign, verify, attest; tag-only). sign runs on tags and on workflow_dispatch from main; release stays tag-only.

sign steps: download artifact; create temp keychain; import p12; set-key-partition-list; codesign --force --options runtime --timestamp --identifier ai.opum.ward --sign IDENTITY; zip; xcrun notarytool submit --wait with API key, require Accepted, keep log; codesign --verify --strict; codesign -d -r- must name team id and ai.opum.ward; cdhash agreement check; upload signed artifact; always-run step deletes the keychain and the key file.
Secrets (environment release): APPLE_CERT_P12_BASE64, APPLE_CERT_PASSWORD, ASC_API_KEY_P8, ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID. Variables (non-secret): APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY, APPLE_TEAM_ID.

Tests, red first: only sign references the five secrets; sign has no bun, npm or install step and no uses outside the pinned set; sign has environment release and the keychain cleanup step has if always(); attest and release need sign; the release job is tag-only and sign is not reachable from a pull_request; codesign line carries --options runtime, --timestamp and --identifier ai.opum.ward; notarytool step fails unless status Accepted; no entitlements file unless the rehearsal cites both runs.
Scripts helper: keychain import and cleanup as a node or sh script under scripts/, tested with a fake security binary on PATH, both ways (import ok, cleanup runs after a failing sign).

Docs: install and publish runbooks, ADR 0001 deferral paragraph, protect runbook (environment targets v* and main, reviewer operator, can_admins_bypass false), certificate expiry date in the publish runbook when created.
Held: no edit to .github/workflows/release.yml, the release test or the scripts helper until opum-agent says go, after #418 lands (opum-ai/ward-cli#418).
